entry_points.text: Two cmdlines skip timer verify and disable pin1 at parse; affinity accepted only if activated, intersecting online then managed or regular placement.
Numeric option sets shorthand with later mode report; 32-bit honors named driver else probes in order installing first claimer else fails boot.

exports.text: Restore programs remembered cascade pin as unmasked edge-high phys ExtINT to boot CPU then optionally detaches bootstrap unit; wrapper no-ops without legacy; tracker starts at none.
Maps one fixed slot plus busy mem extent per unit from table addr or zeroed fallback page, names by index and inserts extents; 32-bit zero disables support; walks units with rising index.
Reserves vectors, matrix and domain with legacy range and count cap; online installs legacy, offline retires moves under lock; claims IOAPIC/HPET; move completes on new CPU, ack advances then EOIs.

IOAPIC pin domain offers create/release/program/mask; MSI refresh builds message from cached target to parent; remap alloc/free moves one IRQ; PCI MSI parent published unless disabled; restore via virt helper.
Default single/all/all-but-self/self wrap mask or shortcut; x2 helper sends vector to explicit ID with caller mode in one write.

hazards.text: Bad broadcast/collision, ID mismatch, missing alloc and 32-bit zero warn with fixup or abort/disable; placement refused while move pending/queued with capacity errors.
Reprogram while remote set silences level so migrate only when clear with flush; level-as-edge needs completion plus misroute count; old pending re-arms, offline warns.
Reschedule to offline warns and drops; NMI to offline needs driver plus prior boot else warns; logical mask including offline warns yet proceeds.

invariants.text: ID init skipped for ACPI/non-Intel/xAPIC; broadcast rejected, collisions take first free below broadcast with table fixup and guarded HW rewrite check; diagnostics dump regs and pin lists.
Startup under guard masks legacy, samples pending and unmasks as chip op; level follows remote bit, active query needs bit plus level; bound base/top/start; polarity alloc/ACPI/PCI.
Remapped entry copies vector/dest/format from parent message to all pins under guard; affinity delegates to parent then reconfigures unless fully handled as chip op.
Create allows one IRQ with valid info, existing desc and unused pin, masks low legacy, links pin/node and starts level masked; free tears down one and warns if linked; idx in host priv.
Single suppresses all-but-self; multi prefers shortcut else iterates online under IRQ suppression with call-func tracking caller; shortcut waits idle; phys per-CPU IDs, logical bits.
Device MSI needs supported bus and PCI flavour, intersects and enforces flags with edge handling; preparation distinguishes MSI-X versus MSI from token.
Records start cleared; refresh under lock binds vector and CPU; install defers if prior online else releases; legacy pinned CPU0 except cascade; creation single-target deferred, disabled fails.
Managed reserves, masked places now, rest reserve globally; placement retains valid else widens to all online under lock; deactivate and free restore reservation or shutdown placeholder.

locks.text: Resume restores drifted IDs in reverse under guard; activation programs entry under guard, deactivation only masks never for multi-pin.
Move clear/queue/arm atomic with timer, offline releases immediately; raw lock blocks online-set changes; activate/cleanup/debug serialize matrix and queues, debug copies under lock.
Remap domain singleton under dedicated mutex with reuse and node release on failure.

state_machines.text: Active prepare masks on pending move if unmasked, finish migrates only when ack clear then restores mask; alternate build inert.
Activation chooses managed versus reserved paths to place reservation or shutdown placeholder into an assigned vector.
MSI affinity delegates then immediate when no reservation, unchanged or around startup else staged redirect on current CPU with mark, completion and retrigger; stray tolerated as spurious.
Broadcast stays disabled when forced off, single-online or never-booted present, and enables only after all clear to protect early boot.

structs.text: Two IOAPIC descs share query/retrigger/affinity/ack/mask/startup differing in level EOI and defer flags; local descs mask/unmask and EOI vector-zero.
Boot storage cleared for unmasked edge-high ExtINT split low/high; suspend saves entries, resume restores IDs then entries via syscore ops registered at init.
Per-IRQ holds cur/prev vector and CPU, flags, HW dest and cleanup link; globals mask/matrix/domain/controller; per-CPU list plus timer; ops select/alloc/free/activate/deactivate/debug.
DMAR edge composes via remap; default 32-bit logical with MMIO waits; broadcast15 name11 reg0 low-word remote trigger bits local mask ver shift max254 matrix floors shutdown marks.
